.AVIATION...

High pressure is reinforced over the Great Lakes while taking a 
position that shifts wind direction from light SW to light NE into 
SE Mi late tonight and Tuesday morning. This creates a chance for 
inland transport of Lake Huron boundary layer moisture capable of 
fog or low stratocu production. It is a low predictability scenario 
but one worth monitoring in observational trends for later updates. 
Conditions are otherwise VFR under clear sky this evening and under 
increasing cirrus later tonight and Tuesday morning. Light easterly 
wind continues during the afternoon into Tuesday evening.
